summary: Feed s107_single is degraded: required VLAN 20 not seen and 50% of packets are untagged. NDR is missing half its required VLAN coverage [10,20]. All other checks (duplicates, encrypted_share, one_way, packet_drops, tool_overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Upstream SPAN or packet broker is stripping 802.1Q tags or VLAN-filtering/pruning VLAN 20. 50% untagged packets indicates trunk tags are not being preserved end-to-end to the NDR tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR is blind to VLAN 20 traffic, losing visibility into 50% of the feed. As an NDR requiring both directions and full payload across VLANs 10 and 20, it cannot detect lateral movement or correlate threats segmented on VLAN 20, significantly reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Configure broker ingress/egress to preserve 802.1Q tags and explicitly forward VLANs 10 and 20 to the NDR port, restoring complete VLAN visibility.
